summary: Iteration 7 verifies the fix for the axios 401 auto-logout UX regression from iter6. Backend: wrong/missing current_password on PUT /api/auth/profile now returns 400 (was 401); factory-reset wrong password also 400. test_iter6 expectations updated 401->400. Frontend: axios interceptor whitelists /auth/profile, /auth/password, /settings/factory-reset from auto-logout. E2E validated: wrong password shows toast 'Password Anda saat ini salah...' on /profile, no redirect, pk_token intact. Correct password saves, login with new phone works, phone restored to 081200000001. Session expiry with junk token still auto-logouts (redirect to /login). Full backend regression: 88/88 passing (test_iter6_phone_change 11, test_pinjamku_flow, test_iter2_features, test_iter4_rbac_regress).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js: REAUTH_PATHS whitelist uses url.startsWith and matches axios config.url (relative to baseURL), correctly skipping auto-logout only for the three self-re-auth endpoints while keeping normal 401s (e.g. GET /dashboard with junk token) triggering logout. Verified.
auth_routes.update_profile now returns HTTP 400 with clear Indonesian message when current_password missing or wrong on phone change — semantically correct because the JWT session itself is valid.
admin_routes.factory_reset returns 400 for wrong password (consistent with the new re-auth semantics).
test_iter6_phone_change.py updated (401->400) to reflect new re-auth status.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (wrong-pw toast, correct save, restore, junk-token logout)

seed_data_creation: Test admin/lender accounts created by iter6 fixtures were auto-cleaned; leftover 081299990099/081299990002 from a prior interrupted run were cleaned manually before test start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 401 interceptor whitelist is enforced in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js via REAUTH_PATHS. Any future re-auth endpoint (e.g. TOTP setup) should be added there. Superadmin phone is restored to 081200000001. Do NOT run test_iter3_factory_reset.py (destructive).
rca of the issue: Fixed. Root cause was global axios 401 handler treating every 401 as session expiry, but re-auth checks (wrong current_password on /auth/profile) legitimately return 401 while the JWT itself is still valid. Fix combines two safeguards: (1) backend changed to 400 for these self-re-auth failures — semantically accurate; (2) frontend interceptor also whitelists these paths defensively. Both verified end-to-end.
